lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-grid pattern posterior to the gills and pectoral fin, centered around a 4x3 grouping of prominent macro-spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity spots are visibly anchored at the intersections of faint vertical bands and horizontal lines, forming a structured checkerboard lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed primarily across the lower half and leading edge of the dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal remora fish (Echeneidae) clustered near the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
